name: Valerick Grumblin
description: Valerick Grumblin is a sharp-eyed, weary-looking guard captain and veteran investigator who has spent decades patrolling the busier wards of Waterdeep. Acutely familiar with the friction points between wealthy nobles, desperate commoners, and violent criminal factions, he walks a difficult line between keeping the peace and navigating the corrupt political pressures of the city's magistrates.
ideals: Order: 'A city without laws is just a slaughterhouse; someone has to keep the streets from tearing themselves apart.'
Pragmatism: 'Keep your head down, follow the chain of command, and don't ask questions about who's paying the higher-ups.'
bonds: The City Watch and his loyal squad of veteran guards.
His precinct and the neighborhood streets he has sworn to keep from descending into total chaos.
flaws: Jaded and cynical, occasionally turning a blind eye to minor infractions if it prevents a larger bloodbath.
speech_patterns: Tired, blunt, and authoritative, speaking with the heavy, no-nonsense cadence of a career officer who has seen it all.
mannerisms: Rubs tired eyes beneath the brim of his helm, rests a heavy hand on the pommel of his longsword, and sighs heavily when dealing with chaotic adventurers.
motivations: To survive his shifts with as few dead bodies on his ledger as possible and maintain a semblance of order in his ward.
knowledge: Extensive understanding of Waterdeep's municipal laws, patrol routes, criminal hotspots, and the political limitations of the City Watch.
gm_notes: Valerick Grumblin serves as a grounded, pragmatic law enforcement contact for the party. He can be used to investigate crimes around Trollskull Alley, issue warnings when the party's activities draw too much public attention, or act as an exhausted ally who looks the other way when heroes bend the rules for the greater good.
